.name: Look up a friend's Steam library
.note: Read a friend's visible Steam games by SteamID64, with name search and playtime sorting.
.description: Read a friend's visible library by SteamID64. Returns AppIDs, game names, and total minutes reported by Steam. If only a display name is known, look up Steam friends first and ask the user to confirm multiple matches. Use term to search names and sortBy=playtime for longest playtime first. Missing playtime is null. A reported zero may also indicate hidden playtime. unavailableNames counts games Steam did not provide names for. Use nextStart for the next page.
.parameters.steamId: The target friend's SteamID64 as a string.
.parameters.term: Case-insensitive partial match on the game name.
.parameters.sortBy: Pass playtime to sort by total minutes descending. Games with missing playtime appear last.
.parameters.start: Zero-based offset. Continue with the previous result's nextStart.
.parameters.limit: 1 to 100 entries per page. The default is 25.
